items.title: Conagra Cut Its Dividend 50%. The Stock Market Was Warning Investors
items.summary: Conagra's falling stock price told one story while its board told another, and the board lost. Four more high-yield payers are sending the same mixed signals, and one cash flow line shows which side to believe.

items.title: Invest $200,000 in These 5 Dividend Stocks to Fund Your Retirement Income
items.summary: Selling shares in a down market can turn a retirement plan into a slow leak. Five dividend payers across five sectors aim to cover the bills instead, but one of them carries $166.2B of debt, and each one hides a risk worth knowing first.

items.title: A $300,000 Portfolio in Omega Healthcare, Edison International and Altria Pays $17,064 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $300,000 portfolio split evenly across Omega Healthcare, Edison International and Altria pays about $17,100 a year in dividends at today’s prices, or about $1,420 a month. Omega is the least covered of the three, paying out 91% of its AFFO in fiscal 2025, though consensus has that easing to 86% in fiscal 2026.

items.title: 5 Dividend Stocks Yielding Over 5% to Hide in Your Roth IRA
items.summary: Five high-yield payers could be quietly handing the IRS thousands of dollars every year, and two of them are taxed far more harshly than the rest. Where you park them matters more than which ones you buy.

items.title: 5 Huge Dividend Payers the IRS Leaves Alone Inside a Roth
items.summary: Two investors can hold the exact same five blue chip dividend stocks and still walk away with very different paychecks. The difference comes down to one account choice, and over 20 years it snowballs into a six-figure surprise.
